title: Croydon Nightbus
description: A slow-burn deep-garage roller at 132 BPM: a swung 2-step 808 shuffle over a rolling, wobbling sub bass that leads the track. Chopped soulful vocal cuts and dub-chord stabs drift through cavernous reverb and delay as the filter slowly opens, hats deepen their swing, and layers fade in and out across an eight-minute-feel arc.
